notes.title: Major Update│Early Access V0.21
notes.content: [p][b]We're Making Progress![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Since our last build, we felt that we wanted to go further with the game and take the time to make a truly outstanding experience. After months of hard work, we've finally firmed up the mechanics, aesthetics and gameplay of Terminal Error. Although this portion of the game is not yet complete, we have made great strides, creating something we believe is exceptional![/p][p][/p][p][b]So, What's New?[/b][/p][p][/p][p]We've expanded the world. Moving out of the Guardhouse, explore [b]The Tunnel[/b], the entrance to the military facility Site 41. Infected by the same flesh-like disease spreading in the Guardhouse, navigate this dangerous space while figuring out how to contain this disaster and get out safely...[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/33218bcd3d09af3d49a67ad593523ea852492317.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Be careful though, you're being hunted...[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/bbb9cafbb6c0c1385912306c0829513cd3916d14.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Fresh New Maps[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Inspired by Brutalist architecture, the new maps come with an oppressive and imposing atmosphere, weighing down on you as you sneak through the eerie corridors and try to avoid whatever is stalking you...[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/56ddd52316925e0bc24906d81547dcf2db7d1d57.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/c64a82af10b6bc1cee1e4f35039d93824007196a.png"][/img] [/p][p]Also expect the grotesque sight of flesh, spreading and infecting the facility as you carefully traverse through it...[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/b8ca5172687580059dd082c819faa350e010032a.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Fresh New Puzzles[/b][/p][p][/p][p]More puzzles and more types of puzzles. We've added a wide array of challenges to overcome. The Terminal Puzzle, Electrical Box and Gear Box are just a few of our exciting  new additions...[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/3afcc5dbc8e9938a10263d5b8e882e4d2ee94d47.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/c8f12bd9e1a372b106f3e735e06352beb31b6fe0.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/51c3e7c57223ef81e46aa4d038b893737c2039a1.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]On top of that, we have new gadgets and interactable objects to mess around with and use throughout the game[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/54a184c7ff0f74520bacf0e708c1e8ce91e8ee0e.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]And this is just the tip of the iceberg[/p][p][/p][p][b]Fresh New Graphics[/b][/p][p][/p][p]As you might've noticed, the shader has also been improved to better fit our unsettling world and add to the horror mystery feeling...[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/3bfb44ca9d65e559283d7fc36b325e1404942b77.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]More graphics and animations have also been added throughout to set the mood and better draw you in to the surreal world of Terminal Error[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/512594c3dbf7734f9f9e0958df74b6f98b9b7e70.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Fresh New Tutorial?[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Even the Tutorial has been touched up, now with improved puzzles and a more refined experience. We have really made huge changes, making the moments more impactful and setting the stage for the world and it's larger plot...[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/c8adddbae7a8235ac78e6925420f650e87c4cec1.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/38f5c7e82f089fc3f70245e1d598acd3a8aecb3b.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]The initial monster encounter has also changed... Just a little...[/p][p][/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/d861632b4abbaf799cc4e61b0c84916fc68195b3.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]What's Next?[/b][/p][p][/p][p]We've worked tirelessly on trying to make this gaming experience something truly special. Although our schedule has been rocky, we'll keep pushing through to make an exceptional game. At our heart, we're gamers like everyone else and simply want to make the best horror thriller game we can.[/p][p][/p][p]Luckily, updates should be coming slightly more often in the foreseeable future. Expect another significant update or two by the end of 2025. We'll also be adding more devlogs where possible to keep everyone updated on our progress, but no promises on how often![/p][p][/p][p]As for localisation and translations, we are still awhile away. As the script and text keep changing, we will only be hopping over to other languages nearer the end of the development cycle. But do not worry! We are committed to bringing Terminal Error to you, so just give us time![/p][p][/p][p]For those who have stuck with us from the start, we really appreciate your support and we want to assure everyone that we aren't quitting until this game in finished and up to the standard we want! We look forward to the feedback and building the best game possible![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/a927dc96abe99105ed8dcd8f2a43850ed7da167a.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: New Update, New Map on the way│Devlog #5
notes.content:
[b]What Do We Have In Store?[/b]

We've been working on the next major update for a while now, and we're getting close to pushing it out there. Currently, we have a massive new map, new minigames and most importantly, monster encounters and interactions in store. This will build off the concepts of the tutorial level and upgrade it to a larger, more dynamic world. 

[b]A Whole New World[/b]

The map we've been working on is nearly complete for now, so here's a little peak into some of what we've been working on...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/2c1e9f1d25ab2a00c842ce07bf2b8db148d91a8b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/9f80bef1063d1f5f979684199f2714bc289a14b6.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/6805df6fc01d8abf25b7a543699e76d9294580b3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/d9064ce4b009db262927a8c7019c3d0b6e992dee.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/30c128665b6ddc8e9c210caa142082e661c0dc2b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/8b02207b2888010d0bd998fea6b7dcba6be5cfef.png[/img]

We'll be releasing more images and updates on our progress in the coming weeks, so stay tuned!

[b]We Need Feedback![/b]

Also, we would really appreciate any feedback for the next part! It's quite a bit more content and we would love to hear more Player comments! We're just two brothers working on this game together... the team is small, and our resources are limited. Because of this, there might be bugs and issues we may have overlooked along the way. As such, feedback is the best way for us to fix and improve our game along the way.

notes.title: Early Access V0.12
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44398718/6927bb9de90c54d92cfc186174a380c3d643cea9.png[/img]

This update includes all the major intended content changes for the Guardhouse. We have added the main monster for the level as well as addressed some bugs and content concerns. Subsequently, we will be moving on to the next map.

[u][b]Updated Content:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Added Saving System
[*] Added Objective System
[*] Added Stalker
[*] Fixed Screen Resolution Bug
[*] Edited Text
[/list]
